data.title: Mobile web: canvas container grows endlessly + controls don't fit small screens

data.body: Human-reported symptoms on mobile web: (1) the image container (editor bezel/canvas) resizes larger endlessly — likely a ResizeObserver/layout feedback loop between the canvas sizing and its container, possibly aggravated by dvh changes when the mobile URL bar hides and DPR=3 rounding; (2) the buttons don't fit the viewport. Product stance: this is desktop software first, but it must WORK on mobile — usable layout, no layout loop, controls reachable — not a fully re-designed mobile UI.

Implemented per plan, 5 commits: (1) grid-editor.ts layout() now measures container.clientWidth/clientHeight (padding box) instead of getBoundingClientRect(), killing the +2px seed, plus a no-op guard that skips canvas.width/height/style writes only when devW/devH/DPR are all unchanged — zoom/checker still recompute unconditionally so focus/cell-size paths work; (2) .bezel gains min-height:0 + contain:size, dvh->svh (vh fallback kept first), <=880 bezel height clamp(240px,45svh,420px); (3) <=640 compact block (wrapping masthead/tb-group/transport, tagline hidden, tighter paddings) + lcd.ts seg-out/seg-focus/seg-sel classes hidden at <=640; (4) border-preview 2x study width min(size,100%) + aspect-ratio 1/1, fluid .bp-grid/.bp-box at <=640; (5) (pointer:coarse) and (max-width:880px) touch-target block. Verified: tsc + vite build clean after every step; headless simulation of the measure->flex-min feedback (50 cycles) reproduces monotonic growth on the old math (+2 css px/tick at 390/DPR3 and 320/DPR2) and proves both the measurement fix alone and the full fix are fixed points (devH constant from tick 1); desktop 1400px row-layout delta is exactly the corrected 2 css px (2*dpr device px) per axis. Grep audits: no getBoundingClientRect in layout's measure path (toArt's canvas rect untouched, per plan), zero dvh tokens, .bezel has min-height:0. Deviations: none. Real-phone pass (URL-bar collapse, criterion 4; touch ergonomics, criterion 5) left for review as planned.

REVIEW (cold, independent): commits 888b2c6..ea4cd20 vs plan. VERDICT: PASS with one minor inline fix (54d81f7). Loop diagnosis re-derived and simulated independently (measure->auto-min iteration, DPR 1/2/3/2.75, fractional bezel heights): OLD getBoundingClientRect-16 diverges +2px/tick (+1.82 at DPR 2.75); NEW clientWidth/Height-16 correctly yields the padding box minus padding = content box (border excluded), converging in <=1 tick even WITHOUT min-height:0; with min-height:0 + contain:size the feedback channel is closed structurally. Worst-case clientHeight rounding puts the canvas ~0.5px into padding - no feedback, invisible. Guard verified by code walk: only devW/devH/canvas.width/height/style writes are gated; dpr, focus/Lf/fx0/fy0, z, ox/oy, checker + drawChecker, laidOutL, needLayout=false all run unconditionally, so focus and cell-size changes (needLayout via store subscription, box unchanged) still recompute zoom/checker; render() clears the full canvas each frame so skipped resizes leave no stale pixels. CSS: zero dvh remains; vh fallbacks precede svh in both places; <=880 bezel clamp(240px,45svh,420px) present; <=640 and coarse-pointer blocks scoped correctly; desktop >=900 diff limited to .bezel loop guards (inert in row layout: min-height is cross-axis, contain:size inert under extrinsic flex sizing) + svh (==dvh with static chrome) + the 2px-smaller canvas the plan predicted. contain:size safe both axes (width=flex stretch, height=explicit clamp; nothing reads bezel content size). LCD seg-out/focus/sel classes wired, hidden only <=640 via display:none - sync() still finds and writes the elements; no aria-live regressions. border-preview update() math otherwise unchanged; desktop 2x study: 100% resolves to 440px column so min(size,100%) = size incl. the 320px max; 158px floor intact. Layout reasoning at 320px: toolbar tb-group + transport wrap, masthead wraps, bp-grid minmax(0,1fr) - no horizontal scroll channel found. tsc + vite build pass; dev server smoke-tested (HTTP 200). DEFECT FOUND + FIXED INLINE (trivial, 1 CSS rule): the <=640 .bp-box max-width:158px also clamped the wide 2x study (inline width:min() does not override max-width), degrading it at large cell sizes to an all-border 158px-declared/256px-used frame with zero content strip - contradicts plan intent; added .bp-item-wide .bp-box { max-width:100% } (54d81f7). Not verified here (needs real phone, per plan): URL-bar scroll behavior, coarse-pointer ergonomics at DPR 3. Meets acceptance criteria 1-3, 6, 7 by code analysis + simulation; 4-5 desktop-verifiable parts confirmed.
